_comment: ops#250 — squasher fleet sweep registry (docs/plans/2026-08-31-ops250-squasher-fleet-sweep.md §2.3). Per-repo gate inputs migrated VERBATIM from the retired per-repo caller workflows (extracted from each repo's origin/main, 2026-08-31). This file is enumeration + gate inputs ONLY — it is NOT class policy: repoClassFor() in scripts/lib/automerge-classify.ts stays the source of truth for train-class/code-fix partitioning. `train: true` = the retired caller had a train_ready leg; the sweep then also enumerates open `queued` PRs for that repo (train invocations pass ONLY train_ready — required_checks/enabled_classes never apply in train mode). Absent optional fields fall back to the reusable gate's own defaults (enabled_classes is written explicitly because the sweep passes inputs positionally — an empty string would OVERRIDE the workflow_call default, not invoke it). 2026-09-06 (Kevin 'go'): code-fix enabled with safe_path_globs on bolt-wms (src/**), studiob (packages/api/src/**) and studiob-price-sync (src/** — extensions/** deliberately OUTSIDE: the checkout extension is customer-facing); asthetik-trade-theme and asthetik-portal stay docs-comment because a storefront/portal change without a QA receipt is Kevin's hand (#475); the code-fix line cap is 400 (automerge-classify.ts); required_checks name each repo's substantive CI job(s) (codex P2 on the door PR: an empty list leaves the named-checks leg fail-closed and the class inert). 2026-09-09 (Kevin 'widen', Engineer sitting — the 46-PR pile-up read: 32 of 46 would have auto-merged under these rules): safe_path_globs widened to scripts/** + docs/** (bolt-wms, studiob, price-sync, webhook-router), studiob to packages/*/src/**; test-only + ci-infra enabled where missing; asthetik-trade-theme gets code-fix on theme paths (a merge only syncs the STAGING theme — the live push stays a Kevin door, #352/#475); asthetik-portal stays without code-fix (Railway auto-deploys main = live, #475); ops-pipeline stays without code-fix (the door must not auto-edit itself); price-sync extensions/** stays out (customer-facing checkout). 2026-09-12 (Kevin 'I want to see all these PRs merged if they're legit and safe' — TP sitting, the org sweep read: 16 green fleet-internal PRs waiting ≈490h across 8 repos, 0 touching a #97 surface/secret/rulebook): the RELEASE leg (`train: true` = the `queued` label door, F1 word: release) is flipped on for claude-config-plane + brain and added for radio, lightsout, client-asthetik at docs-comment squasher scope — the release leg ignores classes anyway; these three earn code-fix only after their own required_checks are named. Library/product/2026-09-12-merge-train-defect-org-sweep.md in the brain is the baseline the next sweep must beat. 2026-09-14 (stint #316, Mechanic — "the door cannot merge the Principal's guard repos"): claude-hooks gains code-fix with safe_path_globs "*.py" (every hook + test lives top-level, one dir deep — the built-in denylist backstop still refuses auth/middleware/pricing-shaped filenames, migrations, and anything under .github/, so a hook whose OWN NAME collides with those markers still waits for a human) and required_checks "syntax" (the repo's one CI job, .github/workflows/python-syntax.yml — named check must be strictly SUCCESS on the head commit, ops#190 B1). settings.json is NOT a path in claude-hooks (it lives in claude-config-plane, already sensitive-pathed there) — a hook's registration (the settings.json entry that wires a merged hook file into an event) is a SEPARATE act on claude-config-plane's live runner branch, never a door PR; see shift-runner/opencode-seat/RULES.md there for the written rule. This entry governs only claude-hooks' own hook-file content. 2026-09-15 stint #361 (L2D-12 — one PR, one door): a `door` field on EVERY row names which train owns the repo's `queued` merge authority — `fleet` or `restart` (the Heritage restart train, heritage-restart-train.yml). client-asthetik is door:restart because its merges ride the restart train's spacing law (deploy window, at-most-one-in-flight); the fleet sweep must NOT enumerate or merge its `queued` PRs, because a fleet merge bypasses that law (client-asthetik#392 merged outside the restart train's spacing law — L2D-12 clause 3). studiob is `train: false` and door:fleet (its merges are door-less, handled by evaluateQueuedOverride); a future routing of studiob through the restart train's door (if its deploy coupling is restored) would set `door: restart` here without touching the train/code-fix partition. `door` is orthogonal to `train` — `train: true` powers the code-fix→candidate partition and is unchanged; `door: restart` means the `queued` enumeration gate lives elsewhere. It is written explicitly on every row; the sweep still reads it as `jq -r \".door // "fleet"\"` so an absent field on a future row fails safe to fleet.
